ingest.note: Audio sent back to the PSTN caller must be G.711 μ-law 8 kHz.

egress.note: Inbound caller audio arrives as G.711 μ-law 8 kHz mono over the media stream WebSocket.

potholes.note: Telephony audio is narrowband μ-law 8 kHz. A decode and resample stage is mandatory before any model.
Plivo uses XML elements to start streaming; the WebSocket connects only after the XML element is processed. Handle the async bridge.
